quote: made me nauseous after wearing it for a few minutes
title: Formula changed after CK sold to Coty, Not the same scent anymore
body: Calvin Klein Eternity was a fragrance I used quite regularly in the mid 1990's. I was so happy to receive a sample to test for review and revisit an old friend. Unfortunately this is not the same fragrance I remember. The original Eternity was a distinctive sexy, clean, floral scent that is hard to forget. This new formula is musky, masculine and made me nauseous after wearing it for a few minutes. I had to take a shower to lose this scent and feel better. This had me curious enough to research this further, after all maybe its just me. Perhaps I don't remember the scent or my body chemistry has changed. Nope, turns out this was sold to Coty in 2005 and the formula was changed. Anyone searching for the original Eternity will need to search for vintage bottles for sale. I'm very disappointed in the changes to the one time beautiful scent. I can't wear this, I no longer like the scent and I certainly don't want to feel sick all day.

title: I think something is wrong with this perfume
body: I bought this because I had the original 25th edition about 10 years ago and I still remember that smell. It was one of my favorite perfumes. The smell was strong and it used to stay on clothes for a long time. This one arrived today around 12 PM. I opened it and honestly the bottle and box looked normal. Nothing looked suspicious. I sprayed it on my T-shirt and immediately I felt something was not right. The smell was completely different from the one I remember. It had a weird smell and after some time I started getting a headache. I thought maybe it was just me, so I changed my shirt and waited. Around 7 PM I checked again because I wanted to be sure. I even took out my old perfume and compared. I was shocked. The perfume I sprayed around noon was completely gone. I mean there was absolutely no smell left. The strange part is in the morning I had bacon and mashed potato fall on the same T-shirt by accident. By evening I could still smell the food on the shirt, but the perfume that I sprayed after that was nowhere to be found. My old 25th edition was nothing like this. Even after washing clothes I could still notice the fragrance. This one disappeared like I never sprayed anything. I don’t know if I got a bad batch or something happened, but this does not smell like the original one I had before. The packaging looks real, but the perfume itself feels completely different. Very disappointed because I bought it expecting the same fragrance I already knew and liked.

title: A little too floral for my tastes but at least it didn't trigger my allergies
body: I have a sensitivity to many perfumes, especially the cheaper ones. When I start dating a woman who wears perfume it can be an issue if I have a reaction to her favorite fragrance. I wanted to see if this perfume would be a problem for me and, fortunately, it wasn't. I had a close friend try it on and my first impression was that it was very floral (maybo TOO floral) in scent. She liked it quite a bit and it didn't seem to trigger my allergies so that is a plus as many perfumes make me sneeze and later I get a headache. I don't know if this will work for others that are allergic to some perfumes, but if you are, you might want to give this one a try.

quote: did not have any adverse reactions to it
title: Not What I Expected
body: I didn't use fragrance for quite a few years due to a relative who was extremely sensitive to it. After her death I never got back into the habit. When offered a bottle of Calvin Klein Eternity for review I decided "Why Not?" What I have recently learned is that I have become sensitive to fragrance myself - at least the widely distributed artificial ones. I did try using the fragrance and did not have any adverse reactions to it. The scent was not overpowering but in fact wore off quickly. That in itself was surprising. I would expect a fragrance by a well-known company such as Calvin Klein to have more staying power. Another thing I noticed is that the product description included natural ingredients such as freesia, mandarin,sage, sandalwood, patchouli, and amber. The ingredients listed on the actual label did not include any of those but was a mostly unpronounceable list of long chemical names such as methoxycinnamate, benzyl salicylate, butylp0henyl Methylpropional, etc. Do perfumers no longer use natural floral components that were once a vital component of fragrance? I did read numerous reviews of this product that claimed what they received was not the true product. I don't know enough about it to know if that is what I received. I do know that after my experience with essential oils, I won't be buying any fragrance produced by Calvin Klein.

quote: This scent did not give my skin any reaction or issue
title: Just buy it already, it’s a amazing scent!
body: I have had this in my cart for a few months & debated on buying without smelling or testing the fragrance out first. Even after I read so many great reviews here on Amazon as well as other sites, I still wasn’t sold. The bottle of perfume I had was running low & I decided to finally give Dossier’s Ambery Vanilla a try because the under $40 vs $100 plus was to tempting. SO happy I did!!! First the presentation & box is simple but in a classy way not over the top with branding, logos or busy designs. The bottle OMG way bigger than expected & well constructed not a cheap felling plastic container, it has heavy. The smell… again OMG it is soooo good! I have not smelled YSL to compare but this is the perfect balance of vanilla, pink pepper & patchouli. Not the intense patchouli from oil or crowd at a Grateful Dead show, it’s like a beautiful earthy smell mixed with deliciousness! I have worn this three times & received compliments each time even after hours of putting it on & seems to last longer than I expected. I do reapply half way through the day but that’s how I am with every perfume I have worn in the past. This scent did not give my skin any reaction or issue & it is a scent I will wear any season or time of the year! I will definitely buy this scent many more times & excited to try some of the other scents from this brands!
